fields.voyage: 7-night Eastern Caribbean, departed Port Canaveral Nov 1
fields.thresholdStatus: Passengers are above 2 percent and below 3 percent. Crew are below 2 percent. A special report for the 2 percent level was sent Nov 5 and the Vessel Sanitation Program was telephoned.
actionsTaken: Ill passengers asked to stay in cabins until 24 hours after symptoms end
Ill food handlers kept off duty for 48 hours after symptoms end
Increased cleaning and disinfection of public areas
Stool specimens collected from ill passengers
fields.reportedBy: Dr. Ines Marlowe, Chief Medical Officer
